templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 送出去一部分弹珠，还剩多少
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q1

stem.en: Mark had {T} marbles. He gave {a} marbles to George and {b} marbles to Nick. How many marbles had Mark left?
stem.zh: 马克有 {T} 颗弹珠。他给了乔治 {a} 颗，又给了尼克 {b} 颗。马克还剩多少颗弹珠？

solution.en: First add the two amounts he gave away: {a}＋{b}＝{a+b}. Then subtract from the total: {T}−{a+b}＝{T-a-b}. Mark has {T-a-b} marbles left.
solution.zh: 先算一共送出去多少：{a}＋{b}＝{a+b} 颗。再从总数里减去：{T}−{a+b}＝{T-a-b}。马克还剩 {T-a-b} 颗。

templates.noFigure: 原题为纯文字应用题（弹珠送出求剩余），无图

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 两条丝带求总长
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q2

stem.en: A yellow ribbon is {d} cm longer than a red ribbon. If the yellow ribbon is {Y} cm long, find the total length of the two ribbons.
stem.zh: 一条黄丝带比红丝带长 {d} 厘米。如果黄丝带长 {Y} 厘米，求两条丝带的总长度。

solution.en: The red ribbon is {d} cm shorter than the yellow, so it is {Y}−{d}＝{Y-d} cm. Total = {Y}＋{Y-d}＝{2*Y-d} cm. (A common mistake is to add the 25 instead of subtracting.)
solution.zh: 红丝带比黄丝带短 {d} 厘米，所以红丝带是 {Y}−{d}＝{Y-d} 厘米。总长＝{Y}＋{Y-d}＝{2*Y-d} 厘米。（常见错误是把「长 {d} 厘米」直接加上而不是先减。）

templates.noFigure: 原题为纯文字应用题（丝带长度），无图

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 买书和笔后剩多少钱
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q3

stem.en: Charles had ${C}. He bought a storybook for ${S} and a pen. If the storybook cost ${d} more than the pen, how much money had Charles left?
stem.zh: 查尔斯有 {C} 元。他买了一本 {S} 元的故事书和一支笔。如果故事书比笔贵 {d} 元，查尔斯还剩多少钱？

solution.en: The pen cost {S}−{d}＝{S-d} dollars (it is {d} dollars cheaper than the book). Total spent = {S}＋{S-d}＝{2*S-d}. Money left = {C}−{2*S-d}＝{C-S-(S-d)} dollars.
solution.zh: 笔比书便宜 {d} 元，所以笔是 {S}−{d}＝{S-d} 元。一共花了 {S}＋{S-d}＝{2*S-d} 元。剩下 {C}−{2*S-d}＝{C-S-(S-d)} 元。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 三个人比多少求第三人的钱
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q4

stem.en: Peter has ${p} more than Tom. Sandy has ${s} less than Peter. If Tom has ${t}, how much money does Sandy have?
stem.zh: 彼得比汤姆多 {p} 元。桑迪比彼得少 {s} 元。如果汤姆有 {t} 元，桑迪有多少钱？

solution.en: Peter has {t}＋{p}＝{t+p}. Sandy has {p} less... wait: Sandy has {s} LESS than Peter, so {t+p}−{s}＝{t+p-s}. Sandy has ${t+p-s}.
solution.zh: 彼得有 {t}＋{p}＝{t+p} 元。桑迪比彼得少 {s} 元，所以是 {t+p}−{s}＝{t+p-s} 元。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 比高比矮求第三人身高
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q5

stem.en: Barry is {x} cm taller than Jeff. Pete is {y} cm shorter than Barry. If Jeff is {J} cm tall, find Pete's height.
stem.zh: 巴里比杰夫高 {x} 厘米。彼得比巴里矮 {y} 厘米。如果杰夫身高 {J} 厘米，求彼得的身高。

solution.en: Barry is {J}＋{x}＝{J+x} cm. Pete is {y} cm shorter than Barry, so {J+x}−{y}＝{J+x-y} cm.
solution.zh: 巴里身高 {J}＋{x}＝{J+x} 厘米。彼得比巴里矮 {y} 厘米，所以是 {J+x}−{y}＝{J+x-y} 厘米。

templates.noFigure: 原题为纯文字应用题（比高矮），无图

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 秤上求水果质量
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q6

stem.en: The mass of the bunch of bananas is {B} g. On the scale, the bananas and a mango together read {T} g. Find the mass of the mango.
stem.zh: 一串香蕉的质量是 {B} 克。秤上放着一串香蕉和一个芒果，总读数是 {T} 克。求芒果的质量。

solution.en: Total on the scale is {T} g; the bananas are {B} g. The mango is the difference: {T}−{B}＝{T-B} g.
solution.zh: 秤上总质量是 {T} 克，香蕉是 {B} 克，芒果就是它们的差：{T}−{B}＝{T-B} 克。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 两根杆子相差多少
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q7

stem.en: The total length of Pole A and Pole B is {S} cm. If Pole A is {A} cm long, how much longer is Pole B than Pole A?
stem.zh: 杆 A 和杆 B 的总长是 {S} 厘米。如果杆 A 长 {A} 厘米，杆 B 比杆 A 长多少厘米？

solution.en: Pole B is {S}−{A}＝{S-A} cm. The difference is {S-A}−{A}＝{S-2*A} cm, so Pole B is {S-2*A} cm longer than Pole A.
solution.zh: 杆 B 是 {S}−{A}＝{S-A} 厘米。差值＝{S-A}−{A}＝{S-2*A} 厘米，所以杆 B 比杆 A 长 {S-2*A} 厘米。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 花完钱后谁多谁少
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q8

stem.en: Dennis had ${d1} and Paul had ${p1}. Dennis spent ${d2} while Paul spent ${p2}. How much more money had Paul left than Dennis?
stem.zh: 丹尼斯有 {d1} 元，保罗有 {p1} 元。丹尼斯花了 {d2} 元，保罗花了 {p2} 元。保罗剩下的钱比丹尼斯多多少？

solution.en: Dennis has {d1}−{d2}＝{d1-d2} left; Paul has {p1}−{p2}＝{p1-p2} left. The difference is {p1-p2}−{d1-d2}＝{(p1-p2)-(d1-d2)}. Paul has ${(p1-p2)-(d1-d2)} more than Dennis.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 两台秤求一个物体的质量
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q9

stem.en: On a scale, {c1} cubes and {b1} circles weigh {s1} kg. On another scale, {c2} cube and {b2} circle weigh {s2} kg. Each cube has the same mass, and each circle has the same mass. Find the mass of one circle.
stem.zh: 一台秤上，{c1} 个方块和 {b1} 个圆球共重 {s1} 千克；另一台秤上，{c2} 个方块和 {b2} 个圆球共重 {s2} 千克。每个方块一样重，每个圆球也一样重。求一个圆球的质量。

solution.en: Second scale: 1 cube＋1 circle＝{s2} kg, so one cube is {s2}−1 circle. Substitute into the first: {c1}×({s2}−circle)＋{b1} circles＝{s1}, i.e. {c1*s2}＋({b1}−{c1}) circle(s)＝{s1}. So one circle＝({s1}−{c1*s2})÷({b1}−{c1})＝{ball} kg.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 两根绳子求总长
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q10

stem.en: String A is {A} cm long. String B is {d} cm shorter than String A. Find the total length of both strings.
stem.zh: 绳子 A 长 {A} 厘米。绳子 B 比绳子 A 短 {d} 厘米。求两条绳子的总长度。

solution.en: String B is {A}−{d}＝{A-d} cm. Total = {A}＋{A-d}＝{2*A-d} cm.
solution.zh: 绳子 B 是 {A}−{d}＝{A-d} 厘米。总长＝{A}＋{A-d}＝{2*A-d} 厘米。

templates.noFigure: 原题为纯文字应用题（两根绳子），无图

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 买东西后剩多少钱
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q11

stem.en: Lucy had ${L}. Julie had ${j} more than Lucy. Julie bought a packet of tissue paper for {c}¢. How much money had she left?
stem.zh: 露西有 {L} 元。朱莉比露西多 {j} 元。朱莉花 {c} 分买了一包纸巾。她还剩多少钱？

solution.en: Julie had {L}＋{j}＝{L+j} dollars. She spent {c}¢＝{c/100} dollars. Left: {L+j}−{c/100}＝{(L+j)-c/100} dollars.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 看秤读数
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q12

stem.en: Look at the scale. What is the mass of the brick?
stem.zh: 看下面的台秤，砖块的质量是多少？

solution.en: Read the position of the needle on the dial: it points to {m} g, so the brick has mass {m} g.
solution.zh: 看表盘上指针的位置：指针指向 {m} 克，所以砖块的质量是 {m} 克。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 找出最小的分数
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q13

stem.en: Which of the following fractions is the smallest?
stem.zh: 下面哪个分数最小？

solution.en: When the top (numerator) is the same, a bigger bottom (denominator) means a smaller fraction. Here 2/{n} is bigger than 1/{n} and 1/{small}. The smallest is 1/{big}, because {big} is the biggest denominator.
solution.zh: 分子相同时，分母越大分数越小。这里 2/{n} 比 1/{n} 和 1/{small} 都大。最小的是 1/{big}，因为 {big} 是最大的分母。

templates.noFigure: 原题为选择题（分数比较，四个选项），无图

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 用尽可能少的硬币付款
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q14

stem.en: Anna has plenty of 5c, 10c, 20c and 50c coins. She buys two items costing {p1} cents and {p2} cents. Anna pays the exact amount using as FEW coins as possible. What is the smallest number of coins she can use?
stem.zh: 安娜有足够多的 5 分、10 分、20 分和 50 分硬币。她买了两件共 {p1} 分和 {p2} 分的商品。安娜用「尽可能少」的硬币正好付款。她最少用多少枚硬币？

solution.en: Total = {p1}＋{p2}＝{price} cents. To use as FEW coins as possible, use the biggest coin (50c) first: {n50}×50c＝{n50*50}, leaving {r50}c; then {n20}×20c leaving {r20}c; then {n10}×10c leaving {r10}c; then {n5}×5c. Total coins = {n50}＋{n20}＋{n10}＋{n5}＝{minCoins}.
solution.zh: 总价＝{p1}＋{p2}＝{price} 分。要用尽可能少的硬币，就优先用最大面值的 50 分：{n50} 枚 50 分＝{n50*50} 分，剩 {r50} 分；再 {n20} 枚 20 分，剩 {r20} 分；再 {n10} 枚 10 分，剩 {r10} 分；最后 {n5} 枚 5 分。总共 {n50}＋{n20}＋{n10}＋{n5}＝{minCoins} 枚。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 每天多取一点，哪天取完
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q15

stem.en: Pirate Pete had {G} {item} in his treasure chest. One day he took out {f} {item}. Each day after, he took out {f} more {item} than he had taken out the day before. On which day did Pirate Pete empty the treasure chest?
stem.zh: 海盗皮特的宝箱里有 {G} 枚金币。某天他取出 {f} 枚。之后每一天他都比前一天多取 {f} 枚。皮特在第几天取空了宝箱？

solution.en: Day 1: {f}; Day 2: {2*f}; Day 3: {3*f} … The amounts go {f}, {2*f}, {3*f}, … They add up to {f}＋{2*f}＋…＋{day}×{f}＝{f}×({1}＋{2}＋…＋{day})＝{G}, which exactly empties the chest. So it is the {day}th day.
solution.zh: 第 1 天取 {f} 枚，第 2 天取 {2*f} 枚，第 3 天取 {3*f} 枚……每天多取 {f} 枚。累加到 {G} 枚正好取空：{f}＋{2*f}＋…＋{day}×{f}＝{G}。所以是第 {day} 天。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 同心正方形最大边长
templates.source: Year 2 数学错题集锦 Q16

stem.en: Mike drew four squares with the same centre. The side length of the smallest square is {s} units. The distance between the squares doubles each time. What is the side length of the largest square?
stem.zh: 迈克画了四个同心的正方形。最小正方形的边长是 {s} 单位。正方形之间的距离每次翻倍。最大的正方形的边长是多少？

solution.en: The gaps between the squares double each time: {s}, {2*s}, {4*s} units. Each side grows by twice a gap, so the sides are {s}, then {s}+{2*s}＝{3*s}, then {3*s}+{4*s}＝{7*s}, then {7*s}+{8*s}＝{15*s}. The largest square has side {maxSide} units.
solution.zh: 正方形之间的距离每次翻倍：{s}、{2*s}、{4*s} 单位。每条边都比里面那条多出「两倍的这段距离」，所以边长依次是 {s}、{s}+{2*s}＝{3*s}、{3*s}+{4*s}＝{7*s}、{7*s}+{8*s}＝{15*s}。最大的正方形边长是 {maxSide} 单位。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 给一本书的所有页码编号用了多少个数字

stem.en: A comic book has {T} pages. How many digits in total are used to number all the pages?
stem.zh: 一本漫画书有 {T} 页。给这本书的所有页码编号，一共要用多少个数字？

solution.en: Pages 1 to 9 need 9 digits (1 digit each). Pages 10 to {T} are {T-9} pages and need {T-9}×2＝{2*T-18} digits. Altogether: 9＋{2*T-18}＝{ans} digits.
solution.zh: 第 1–9 页每页 1 个数字，共 9 个；第 10–{T} 页一共有 {T-9} 页，每页 2 个数字，共 {T-9}×2＝{2*T-18} 个。合计 9＋{2*T-18}＝{ans} 个数字。

templates.noFigure: 原题为纯文字应用题（数页码用到的数字个数），无配图

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 数字三角形第几行的最后一个数

stem.en: In the number pattern below, what is the last number in the {n}th row?
stem.zh: 下面的数字三角形按规律排列，第 {n} 行的最后一个数是多少？

solution.en: Row 1 has 1 number, row 2 has 2, row 3 has 3 … so row {n} has {n} numbers and ends at the {ans}th number of the sequence 1, 2, 3, 4, … The last number of row {n} is 1＋2＋…＋{n}＝{n}×{n+1}÷2＝{ans}.
solution.zh: 第 1 行 1 个数、第 2 行 2 个数、第 3 行 3 个数……所以第 {n} 行有 {n} 个数，行末就是整个数列 1,2,3,4,… 的第 {ans} 个数。第 {n} 行最后一个数 ＝ 1＋2＋…＋{n} ＝ {n}×{n+1}÷2 ＝ {ans}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 每人多分一颗就由余变缺

stem.en: Lily has some sweets. If she gives each child {a} sweets, there are {b} sweets left. If she gives each child {a1} sweets, she needs {c} more sweets. How many sweets does Lily have?
stem.zh: 莉莉有一些糖果。如果每个小朋友分 {a} 颗，还剩 {b} 颗；如果每个小朋友分 {a1} 颗，还差 {c} 颗。莉莉一共有多少颗糖果？

solution.en: From {a} sweets each to {a1} sweets each, every child takes 1 more sweet. The sweets change from {b} left over to {c} short, a difference of {b+c} sweets, so there are {b+c} children. Sweets ＝ {a}×{b+c}＋{b} ＝ {ans}.
solution.zh: 每人从 {a} 颗变成 {a1} 颗，每人多拿 1 颗；糖果从「剩 {b} 颗」变成「差 {c} 颗」，相差 {b+c} 颗，正好等于人数，所以有 {b+c} 个小朋友。糖果数 ＝ {a}×{b+c}＋{b} ＝ {ans} 颗。

templates.noFigure: 原题为纯文字应用题（盈亏问题），无配图

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 鸡和兔一共几条腿

stem.en: The farmer has {N} chickens and rabbits. He counted that there are {L} legs altogether. How many rabbits does the farmer have?
stem.zh: 农场主养了 {N} 只鸡和兔。他数出它们一共有 {L} 条腿。农场主养了多少只兔？

solution.en: If all {N} were chickens there would be 2×{N}＝{2*N} legs. The extra {L-2*N} legs come from the rabbits, 2 extra legs each, so there are {L-2*N}÷2＝{ans} rabbits.
solution.zh: 假设 {N} 只全是鸡，只有 2×{N}＝{2*N} 条腿。实际多了 {L-2*N} 条腿，每只兔比鸡多 2 条腿，所以兔有 {L-2*N}÷2＝{ans} 只。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 2 月 1 日是星期几，3 月 1 日就是星期几

stem.en: The 1st of February fell on a {wn} some years ago. On which day of the week was the 1st of March in that same year? There are {dm} days in February that year. You may use the table to assist you.
stem.zh: 某年 2 月 1 日是{wnZh}。那一年的 3 月 1 日是星期几？那一年 2 月有 {dm} 天。可以借助下面的表格。

derived.wnZh: sel(wd-1,'星期日','星期一','星期二','星期三','星期四','星期五','星期六')
derived.wn2Zh: sel(wd2-1,'星期日','星期一','星期二','星期三','星期四','星期五','星期六')

solution.en: February has {dm} days. {dm}÷7 leaves a remainder of {dm-28} day, so the 1st of March is {dm-28} day(s) after the {wn}. That is {wn2}.
solution.zh: 2 月有 {dm} 天，{dm}÷7 余 {dm-28}，所以 3 月 1 日比 2 月 1 日晚 {dm-28} 天，是{wn2Zh}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 3×3 方阵里每行每列都多同一个数

stem.en: Find the missing number in the number puzzle below.
stem.zh: 求下面数字方阵中缺少的数。

solution.en: Going one cell right or one cell down adds {s} (for example {b}→{b+s} and {b+s}→{b+2*s}). The missing cell is two rows down and two columns right of {b}, so it is {b}＋4×{s}＝{ans}.
solution.zh: 每往右一格或往下一格都加 {s}（例如 {b}→{b+s}、{b+s}→{b+2*s}）。缺的那一格在 {b} 的右下两行两列，所以是 {b}＋4×{s}＝{ans}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 阶梯网格里从 A 到 B 的最短路线有几条

stem.en: Find the number of shortest paths from A to B using the gridlines shown below.
stem.zh: 沿着下面图中的网格线，从 A 到 B 的最短路线一共有多少条？

solution.en: Use the adding method: write 1 at A, then at every corner write the sum of the numbers on the corners you can come from (left and below). Following the staircase of {n} steps up to B gives {ans} shortest paths.
solution.zh: 用标数法：A 点写 1，之后每个拐点写「能走到它的相邻拐点」上的数之和（左边和下边）。沿着 {n} 级阶梯一路标到 B，得到最短路线 {ans} 条。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 每行前两格叠在一起就是第三格

stem.en: Find the missing figure in the diagram below.
stem.zh: 找出下面图形方阵中缺少的那一个。

solution.en: In every row, lay the first figure on top of the second one — the third figure is exactly what you get (all the lines of both, none left out). In row 3 the first figure is the “5” shape with a vertical line down the middle, the second is the same “5” shape, so their overlay is still that “5” shape with the vertical line: option D.
solution.zh: 每一行把前两格的图形叠在一起，就得到第三格（两条图形的所有线段都保留）。第三行第 1 格是「5」字形再加一条竖直中线，第 2 格是同样的「5」字形，叠加后还是「5」字形带竖中线，所以选 D。

templates.noVariantReason: 叠加规律图形题：原卷就是这一组图形，随机换线段会破坏「前两格叠加＝第三格」的对应关系，因此保留原题不随机化。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 图里一共有多少个三角形

stem.en: How many triangles are there in the figure below?
stem.zh: 下图一共有多少个三角形？

solution.en: The figure is the triangle plus {m} lines from the bottom-left corner to the right side and 1 line from the left side to the bottom-right corner — {m+4} straight lines in all. Any 3 of them make a triangle except the ones we pick all from the {m+2} lines through the bottom-left corner or all 3 through the bottom-right corner: {m+4}C3 － {m+2}C3 － 1 ＝ {ans}.
solution.zh: 图里一共有 {m+4} 条直线：三角形的三条边、{m} 条从左下顶点连到右边的线、1 条从左边连到右下顶点的线。任取 3 条都能围成三角形，除非这 3 条都过左下顶点（{m+2} 条里取 3 条）或都过右下顶点（3 条里取 3 条）：C({m+4},3) − C({m+2},3) − 1 ＝ {ans} 个。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 闭眼摸球，保证摸到几个同色

stem.en: There are {c1} green, {c2} white, {c3} red and {c4} orange balls in a bag. Shawn is blind-folded. He was asked to select balls from the bag. At least how many balls must he select to ensure that he will have {k} balls of the same colour?
stem.zh: 袋子里有 {c1} 个绿球、{c2} 个白球、{c3} 个红球和 {c4} 个橙球。肖恩蒙着眼睛从袋子里摸球。他至少要摸出多少个球，才能保证其中有 {k} 个同色的球？

solution.en: Think of the worst luck: he could draw {k-1} balls of every colour — {k-1}×4＝{(k-1)*4} balls — and still not have {k} of one colour. The next ball, number {(k-1)*4+1}, must make {k} of some colour. So he needs {ans} balls.
solution.zh: 想最倒霉的情况：每种颜色都只摸到 {k-1} 个，共 {k-1}×4＝{(k-1)*4} 个，还是没有 {k} 个同色。再摸第 {ans} 个，无论什么颜色都会凑成 {k} 个同色。所以至少要摸 {ans} 个。

templates.title: 一排花盆之间的距离与走廊长度

stem.en: {N} pots of flowers were placed evenly along the school corridor starting at the end of the corridor. The distance between every 2 pots is {d} m. How long is the corridor?
stem.zh: {N} 盆花从走廊的一端开始，沿走廊等距离摆放。相邻两盆花之间相距 {d} 米。这条走廊有多长？

solution.en: {N} pots in a row make only {N-1} gaps (the two end pots do not create a gap outside). {N-1}×{d}＝{ans}, so the corridor is {ans} m long.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 找出 ⊙ 的运算含义

stem.en: Given that {a1} ⊙ {b1} = {r1},   {a2} ⊙ {b2} = {r2},   {a3} ⊙ {b3} = {r3}, find the value of {a4} ⊙ {b4}.

solution.en: Try the examples: {a1}⊙{b1} looks like “the first number times itself, minus the second”. Check: {a2}×{a2}−{b2}＝{r2} ✓ and {a3}×{a3}−{b3}＝{r3} ✓. So a⊙b ＝ a×a − b, and {a4}⊙{b4}＝{a4}×{a4}−{b4}＝{ans}.
solution.zh: 看例子找规律：{a1}⊙{b1} 像是「前一个数自己乘自己，再减去后一个数」。验算：{a2}×{a2}−{b2}＝{r2} ✓，{a3}×{a3}−{b3}＝{r3} ✓。所以 a⊙b ＝ a×a − b，{a4}⊙{b4}＝{a4}×{a4}−{b4}＝{ans}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 三个三角形同一位置上的数加起来相等

stem.en: Find the missing number in the number puzzle below.
stem.zh: 求下面数字谜中缺少的数。

solution.en: Read the three triangles as one table. Top row: {t1}+{t2}+{t3} = {S}. Bottom-left row: {l1}+{l2}+{l3} = {S}. So the three numbers in the same position always add up to {S}. The bottom-right row must also give {S}, and {r1}+{r2} = {r1+r2}, so the missing number is {S}-{r1+r2} = {ans}.
solution.zh: 把三组三角形当成一张表看：上面一行 {t1}+{t2}+{t3}={S}，左下这一行 {l1}+{l2}+{l3}={S}，也就是「同一个位置」上的三个数加起来总是 {S}。右下这一行同样要等于 {S}，而 {r1}+{r2}={r1+r2}，所以缺的数是 {S}-{r1+r2}={ans}。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 每个女孩 4 个气球、每个男孩 2 个

stem.en: There were {N} children at a Chinese New Year Party. Each girl was given 4 balloons, each boy was given 2 balloons. Altogether, {T} balloons were given out. How many girls were at the party?
stem.zh: 春节聚会上有 {N} 个小朋友。每个女孩分到 4 个气球，每个男孩分到 2 个气球，一共分出去 {T} 个气球。聚会上有多少个女孩？

solution.en: If all {N} children were boys they would get 2×{N}＝{2*N} balloons. The extra {T-2*N} balloons come from the girls, 2 extra each, so there are {T-2*N}÷2＝{ans} girls.
solution.zh: 假设 {N} 个全是男孩，只要 2×{N}＝{2*N} 个气球。实际多出的 {T-2*N} 个气球来自女孩，每个女孩比男孩多 2 个，所以女孩有 {T-2*N}÷2＝{ans} 个。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 每行个数递增，第 n 行末尾是 n 的平方

stem.en: Find the last number in row {n}.
stem.zh: 求第 {n} 行最后一个数。

solution.en: Row 1 ends at 1, row 2 at 4, row 3 at 9, row 4 at 16 — the last number of row k is k×k. So row {n} ends at {n}×{n}＝{ans}. (Check: row 3 has 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 — that is 5 numbers, and 9＝3×3.)
solution.zh: 第 1 行末尾是 1，第 2 行 4，第 3 行 9，第 4 行 16 —— 第 k 行最后一个是 k×k。所以第 {n} 行末尾是 {n}×{n}＝{ans}。（验证：第 3 行是 5、6、7、8、9 共 5 个数，末尾 9＝3×3。）

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 从 3 月某日推算 4 月某日是星期几

stem.en: The {d1}th of March fell on a {wn}. On which day of the week was the {d2}th of April in that same year? You may use the table to assist you.
stem.zh: 某年 3 月 {d1} 日是{wnZh}。那一年的 4 月 {d2} 日是星期几？可以借助下面的表格。

derived.wn2Zh: sel(wd2-1,'星期日','星期一','星期二','星期三','星期四','星期五','星期六')

solution.en: From {d1} March to {d2} April: (31−{d1})＋{d2}＝{off} days. {off}÷7 leaves a remainder of {rem}, so the weekday moves on by {rem} day(s) from {wn}: that is {wn2}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 每人 10 颗剩 3 颗、每人 11 颗差 2 颗

stem.en: A teacher has a bag of sweets. If she gives each student {a} sweets, {b} sweets will remain. If she wishes to give each student {a1} sweets, she will be short of {c} sweets. How many sweets does the teacher have?
stem.zh: 老师有一袋糖。如果每个学生分 {a} 颗，还会剩下 {b} 颗；如果每个学生分 {a1} 颗，就还差 {c} 颗。老师一共有多少颗糖？

solution.en: Each student gets 1 more sweet, and the sweets go from {b} left over to {c} short — a difference of {b+c} sweets. That difference is exactly 1 sweet per student, so there are {b+c} students. Sweets ＝ {a}×{b+c}＋{b} ＝ {ans}.
solution.zh: 每个学生多分 1 颗，糖果就从「剩 {b} 颗」变成「差 {c} 颗」，相差 {b+c} 颗。这个差正好是每人多分的 1 颗，所以有 {b+c} 个学生。糖果数 ＝ {a}×{b+c}＋{b} ＝ {ans} 颗。

stem.en: There are {c1} red balls, {c2} green balls, {c3} yellow balls and {c4} white {plu} in a bag. Jane is blindfolded. At least how many balls must she remove from the bag to guarantee she has drawn 3 balls of the same colour?
stem.zh: 袋子里有 {c1} 个红球、{c2} 个绿球、{c3} 个黄球和 {c4} 个白球。简蒙着眼睛摸球。她至少要摸出多少个球，才能保证其中一定有 3 个同色的球？

solution.en: Worst luck: take as many as possible without having 3 of one colour — at most 2 red, 2 green, 2 yellow, and {c4} white (there are only {c4}). That is 2＋2＋2＋{c4}＝{ans-1} balls. The next ball must give 3 of one colour, so {ans} balls are needed.

templates.title: 三行数字方阵，每列相邻两行的差递增

stem.en: Find the missing number.

solution.en: Look at each column from the top row down. Col 1 drops by {k}, then by {3*k}＋{k}＝{4*k}; col 2 drops by {2*k}, then by {3*k}＋{2*k}＝{5*k}; col 3 drops by {3*k}, then by {3*k}＋{3*k}＝{6*k}. So the missing number is {a3}−{3*k}−{6*k}＝{ans}.

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 除以 5 余 4、除以 3 余 2、除以 2 余 1

stem.en: When n is divided by 5, the remainder is 4. When n is divided by 3, the remainder is 2. When n is divided by 2, the remainder is 1. Given that {hi} > n > {lo}, find n.
stem.zh: n 除以 5 余 4，除以 3 余 2，除以 2 余 1。已知 {hi} > n > {lo}，求 n。

solution.en: Each remainder is exactly 1 less than its divisor, so n＋1 is a multiple of 5, of 3 and of 2 — that is a multiple of 30. In the range {lo} to {hi} the only multiple of 30 is {30*m}, so n ＝ {30*m} − 1 ＝ {ans}. Check: {ans}÷5 leaves 4, {ans}÷3 leaves 2, {ans}÷2 leaves 1.
solution.zh: 每个余数都比除数少 1，所以 n＋1 同时是 5、3、2 的倍数，也就是 30 的倍数。在 {lo} 到 {hi} 之间只有 {30*m} 是 30 的倍数，所以 n ＝ {30*m} − 1 ＝ {ans}。检验：{ans}÷5 余 4、÷3 余 2、÷2 余 1。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 两列火车相向而行，几小时相遇

stem.en: The distance between 2 train stations, A and B, is {D} km. A train travels from A at a speed of {v1} km/h. Another train travels from B at the same time. What is the speed, in km/h, of the 2nd train, if the two trains meet {t} hours later?
stem.zh: A、B 两个火车站相距 {D} 千米。一列火车以每小时 {v1} 千米的速度从 A 站开出，另一列火车同时从 B 站开出。两车 {t} 小时后相遇，第二列火车的速度是每小时多少千米？

solution.en: The two trains together cover {D} km in {t} hours, so their speeds add up to {D}÷{t}＝{v1+v2} km/h. The 2nd train goes {v1+v2}−{v1}＝{ans} km/h.
solution.zh: 两车 {t} 小时一共走了 {D} 千米，所以速度和是 {D}÷{t}＝{v1+v2} 千米/时。第二列火车的速度 ＝ {v1+v2}−{v1}＝{ans} 千米/时。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 带字母标注的三角形里数三角形

stem.en: How many triangles are there in the figure below?
stem.zh: 下图一共有多少个三角形？

solution.en: Altogether there are {m+4} straight lines: AB, BC, CA, the {m} lines from A to the bottom side, and DC. Three lines make a triangle unless all three pass through one point. The {m+2} lines through A give C({m+2},3) bad choices and the 3 lines through C give 1 more, so the number of triangles is C({m+4},3) − C({m+2},3) − 1 ＝ {ans}.
solution.zh: 图里一共有 {m+4} 条直线：AB、BC、CA、从 A 连到底边的 {m} 条线，以及 DC。任取 3 条就能围成一个三角形，除非这 3 条都过同一个点。过 A 的 {m+2} 条线里取 3 条要排除，过 C 的 3 条线也排除 1 组，所以三角形个数 ＝ C({m+4},3) − C({m+2},3) − 1 ＝ {ans} 个。

templates.subject: 数学
templates.title: 加、乘、减、除之后得到 7，原数是多少

stem.en: {a} is added to a number m. The result of the addition is multiplied by {b}. {c} is subtracted from the result of the multiplication. The result is {e} when it is finally divided by {d}. What is m?
stem.zh: 一个数 m 先加上 {a}，所得的和再乘 {b}，所得的积再减去 {c}，最后除以 {d} 得到 {e}。m 是多少？

solution.en: Work backwards. Before the last division the number was {e}×{d}＝{e*d}. Before subtracting {c} it was {e*d}＋{c}＝{e*d+c}. Before multiplying by {b} it was {e*d+c}÷{b}＝{x+a}. So m ＝ {x+a}−{a}＝{ans}.
solution.zh: 倒着推。最后一步除以 {d} 之前是 {e}×{d}＝{e*d}；减去 {c} 之前是 {e*d}＋{c}＝{e*d+c}；乘 {b} 之前是 {e*d+c}÷{b}＝{x+a}。所以 m ＝ {x+a}−{a}＝{ans}。
